name: Tennis
description: Tennis from the lawns of Wimbledon to the four Grand Slams and the Open Era: the tournaments and the greatest players.

checkpoints.name: Lawn tennis
checkpoints.note: Lawn tennis begins in England. Wimbledon starts in 1877, and the other Grand Slams follow. Lenglen and Laver are its stars, but the best professionals are kept out.

checkpoints.name: The Open Era
checkpoints.note: Professionals join in 1968. King, Borg, Navratilova, Graf and Sampras win on television around the world.

checkpoints.name: The Big Three and after
checkpoints.note: Federer, Nadal and Djokovic win more than sixty Grand Slams between them, Serena Williams wins twenty-three, and Alcaraz and Sinner take over.
